summary: Trait description is inaccurate (no methods defined here) and method Scaladoc lacks a return-value statement.

resolved_items.instruction: Change the trait description to state that it provides an implicit conversion to [[scala.util.ChainingOps]] for any type, rather than claiming it provides chaining methods directly.

Rephrase the first sentence to a standalone declarative summary that states the return value, e.g. 'Wraps the given value in a [[scala.util.ChainingOps]] instance.', since the current sentence is a fragment and the return value is not fully stated.
Leave the @param and @tparam descriptions as 'the value to be wrapped' / 'the type of the value to be wrapped' for concision, since 'wrapped' is accurate given ChainingOps stores the value.

disagreements.accuracy_position: Wanted to replace 'Returns a wrapper' with 'Creates a new ChainingOps instance wrapping the given value' because 'wrapper' is vague; also flagged @param/@tparam 'wrapped' wording as a nit.
disagreements.style_position: Wanted a standalone first sentence mentioning the return type (e.g. 'Wraps the given value in a ChainingOps instance') and flagged the sentence fragment as a nit.
disagreements.rationale: Both agree the current sentence is inadequate; 'ChainingOps instance wrapping the given value' satisfies accuracy (real return type) and style (declarative standalone summary).

disagreements.accuracy_position: Description is factually incorrect because the trait provides only a conversion, not the chaining methods (pipe/tap) which live in ChainingOps.
disagreements.style_position: Wanted to broaden the description to mention tap/pipe and fluent transformations.
disagreements.rationale: The trait body contains only the implicit conversion; stating it provides chaining methods directly is false, so the description must say it provides a conversion to ChainingOps.
